title: store action
description: Gets, puts or removes an entry of a store that dil.core.stores declares (store:<name>). get sets headerName, or else the body, to the value; a key that is not set changes nothing, unless default gives a value. put keeps the value with its type; a new key in a full store fails.

path.title: Store
path.description: Name of the store, from the URI (store:<name>, or store:<namespace>:<name> from an import)

key.title: Key
key.description: Simple expression for the key, such as ${header.orderId}; 1 to 4096 bytes

value.title: Value
value.description: put: simple expression for the value

headerName.title: Header name
headerName.description: get: the header that gets the value; without it, the body does

default.title: Default
default.description: get: simple expression for the value of a key that is not set; without it nothing changes
